examples.timestamp_scope: Per-frame error strings are retained without packet indices/timestamps. First feed and decoder overlap are exact work/packet records; the exact failing feed timestamp is not recoverable from these records.

ingress_diagnosis.scope: GF03 busy is a retained ingress rejection, not an AR03 entropy error. Feed-operation rejection counts and terminal frame NACK counts differ. Packet-consumed credits do not grant frame ingress capacity. No per-feed slot-state trace is retained; partial-frame occupancy after rejection is a mechanism to test, not proven by these summaries.

timing_scope: Untimed retained-result reconciliation. Host stage costs were measured independently per profile; ESP CPU/QSPI/FIFO/link/vblank remain assumptions. No FPGA entropy-cycle/memory/scanline timing integration, nativeexecution,RFcalibrationorphysical30fps proof.
count_scope: Strict presentations occur before capture endpoint; eventual include declared drain. Rolling-window ID rate is neither capture rate nor longrun cadence proof. Source-hash and decoded-hash uniqueness are separately counted. Packet-consumed PC18 and decoded-reference AF03 ACKs remain distinct.
